channel.title: Dumb Game Lab Blog
channel.description: Korean everyday places, cozy idle tycoons, and notes from a tiny game studio in Seoul.

item.title: My daily revenue fell to a thirtieth: 92% of 14 days of income was one article
item.description: A solo dev split mobile game revenue by game and found out why. Of $260 earned in 14 days, $241 came from one game, mostly from traffic that one Taiwanese article created. Here is where I misread it.

item.title: Olympic Gold Medals Are Mostly Silver
item.description: An Olympic gold medal is silver coated with 6 g of gold.

item.title: In a Korean spa tycoon game, where you place things decides your income more than what you buy
item.description: Where do you place things in a Korean spa game to earn 20% more, and where do you lose 20%? The adjacency multiplier table, air conditioner range and door position from the game's real values.

item.title: We Almost Answered the Phone With Ahoy
item.description: Bell wanted ahoy as the phone greeting, but Edison's hello caught on.

item.title: Why Korean PC bangs started selling food like restaurants, not just game time
item.description: Why do Korean PC bangs sell ramen, fried rice and chicken? The 2013 smoking ban, the 2010 food-snitch crackdown, and food sales going from about 10% to 40%, with sources.

item.title: QR Codes Were Born on a Go Board
item.description: QR codes were made in Japan in 1994, inspired by the black and white pattern of Go stones.

item.title: I tried to crash my own app to test crash reporting, and it wouldn't crash
item.description: A solo dev added a switch to crash an iOS app on purpose and test crash reporting, and the app wouldn't crash. Then Play pre-launch report errors got counted as user errors. Two wrong calls from week one.

item.title: Ketchup Used to Be Fish Sauce
item.description: Ketchup was first a word for pickled fish brine, and tomato ketchup came along in the 1800s.

item.title: 10 itch.io games, 327 views and 0 sales in 2 weeks: where I went wrong
item.description: A solo dev uploaded 10 web games to itch.io and got 327 views and 0 sales in 2 weeks. Here is where my plan went wrong, why I wrote devlogs the same day, and when I check again.

item.title: Morning You Is Taller Than Evening You
item.description: People are tallest in the morning and a little shorter by the afternoon. In space, they get about 2.5 cm taller.

item.title: Finished Kairosoft? 14 games to play next, sorted by what you loved
item.description: If you have played through Kairosoft, here are 14 games sorted into four flavors: short grow-it sessions, running a shop, watching residents live, and layout puzzles. Steam list prices, review scores and UI languages checked by hand.

item.title: Your Dog Can Catch Your Yawns
item.description: Yawns don't just spread between people. They can spread to other animals too, like dogs.

item.title: Internet Cafe Tycoon, first 30 minutes: what to buy and when the money starts to stack
item.description: A beginner guide to Internet Cafe Tycoon, built from a fresh save played through 15 in-game days (30 real minutes). When the first PC pays off, the ₩130,000 stage 2 mark, the ₩490,000 stage 3 mark, and why hoarding cash cut daily sales by 39%.

item.title: Space Comes in Three Words
item.description: An astronaut can't go to the universe. They're already inside it.

item.title: Sea Otters Hold Hands While They Sleep
item.description: Sea otters hold hands in their sleep so they don't drift apart, and they carry a favorite rock under one arm.

item.title: OK Started as a Joke About Bad Spelling
item.description: OK is a joke misspelling of all correct as oll korrect that survived by riding an election slogan.

item.title: Bananas Are Berries
item.description: In botany, bananas and tomatoes are berries, while strawberries and raspberries are not.

item.title: GPS Satellite Clocks Are Set Slow on Purpose
item.description: Because of relativity, GPS satellite clocks run 38 microseconds fast each day. So before launch, they're set to run slow on purpose.

item.title: The First Barcode Scan Was Gum
item.description: The barcode came from Morse code drawn in sand, and the first thing scanned was gum.

item.title: Babies Are Born Without Kneecaps
item.description: A baby's kneecaps are cartilage and start turning into bone around age three. The number of bones actually goes down as you grow.

item.title: Repeat a Word and Its Meaning Disappears
item.description: Repeat the same word again and again and its meaning briefly disappears. This is called semantic satiation.

item.title: There's a Rat That's 37 Years Old
item.description: The naked mole-rat lives more than 37 years, and its chance of dying doesn't go up as it gets older.

item.title: Newton Was a Detective Who Caught Counterfeiters
item.description: Newton spent the last 30 years of his life at the Royal Mint, and even went in disguise to get 28 counterfeiters punished.

item.title: Do-Re-Mi Used to Be Ut-Re-Mi
item.description: Do-re-mi comes from the first syllable of each line of an 11th-century Latin chant, and do was originally ut.

item.title: In Antarctica, Even the Time Zone Follows the Delivery Guy
item.description: The South Pole station runs on New Zealand time, because that's where its supplies are sent from.

item.title: Koala Fingerprints Can Pass for Human Ones
item.description: Koala fingerprints look so much like human ones that they're hard to tell apart even under an electron microscope.

item.title: One press release email, one article in Taiwan: the email, the article side by side, and 8 days of traffic
item.description: One short press release email to Bahamut GNN in Taiwan became an article 11 and a half hours later. The exact email structure, what the reporter copied, how long the traffic lasted and how many players were left after 7 days.

item.title: Korean sauna eggs and sikhye: what a jjimjilbang actually sells
item.description: Not a recipe. A fact check of what a jjimjilbang snack counter sells: how Korean sauna eggs differ from boiled eggs, whether sikhye is alcoholic, sikhye vs makgeolli, calories, halal, what they cost in won, and why you should not crack one on your forehead.

item.title: What is an idle tycoon game? A shop that keeps running after you close the app
item.description: An idle tycoon game is a business-management game with automatic and offline earnings. How it differs from clickers, five systems that make money pile up, and what offline earnings really come to, using our own game's numbers.

item.title: Onsen and bathhouse games: 8 compared by what the store pages say
item.description: Onsen and bathhouse games from Steam, Google Play and the App Store in one table: price, rating, idle or not, Korean and Japanese support, plus the weak spots of our own game.
